label: rem:st-is-median-resummation
title: The standard-part map acts as Écalle median resummation on transseries values
html:
Remark. The standard-part map acts as Écalle median resummation on transseries values

The standard-part map \mathrm{st} (standard-part functor) and the median resummation \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{med}} of Écalle–Borel resummation compute the same value wherever both are defined. This remark records the identification once, at block level; it was previously stated only in passing inside the surreal Kashaev reformulation.

Concretely: let \tilde f be a Gevrey-1 transseries whose Borel transform admits lateral Laplace sums along a Stokes ray. The two lateral sums \mathcal{L}^{\theta^\pm}\tilde f disagree by exponentially small terms; the median sum \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{med}}\tilde f is the unique real single-valued average. On the surreal side, the same \tilde f is a transseries in the sense of Berarducci–Mantova [berarducci-mantova2018], hence evaluates at a positive infinitesimal (or, for asymptotic-in-n series, at n = \omega) to a finite element of \mathbf{No}, and \mathrm{st} projects that element to \mathbb{R}. Selecting the real single-valued representative is precisely what \mathrm{st} does to the finite surreal value:

  \mathrm{st}\bigl(\tilde f\,\big|_{\,\varepsilon}\bigr)
  \;=\; \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{med}}\tilde f ,

read as an identity of the two selection rules, not as a new theorem: each side is the unique real, single-valued value compatible with the asymptotics of \tilde f (Watson/Nevanlinna–Sokal uniqueness supplies the analytic half; the valuation quotient \mathcal{O}/\mathfrak{m} \cong \mathbb{R} supplies the surreal half).

Three consequences:

  1. Directionality of the citation graph. Resurgence-side blocks and witnesses (the alien datum, Borel-singularity probes, saddle transseries) may cite this result when they take a real value of a resummed series; the surreal appendix no longer needs to restate the analytic machinery.
  2. The Kashaev application. In the surreal Kashaev statement the map \mathrm{st} applied to 2\pi \log |J_K(\zeta_\omega, \omega)| / \omega is the median resummation of the Kashaev transseries at the root of unity — the asymptotic-limit content of the volume conjecture in resummation form.
  3. Scope. The identification is language-level: it names one operation consistently across the two vocabularies. It does not enlarge the class of summable series and does not touch the genuinely geometric inputs (hyperbolic volume).
